exercises.name: Strake rygghev i apparat
exercises.description: Ligg med hoftene på puten og anklene fast under rullen. Senk overkroppen rolig ned forbi vannrett, løft tilbake til helt rett linje med beina, hold kort og senk igjen.
exercises.startImagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural | Asset type: start frame for an exercise demonstration video, landscape 16:9, wide fixed camera from the side | Input image: identity reference - keep exactly this woman, dark hair tied back, grey sleeveless tank top, black full-length leggings, plain black training shoes | Equipment: a modern 45-degree back extension machine with a silver-grey steel frame, a large black hip pad, black ankle rollers and a weight-stack housing behind the bench, no branding | Pose: the bottom position of a back extension - she is positioned on the machine with her hips resting on the hip pad, both ankles secured under the ankle rollers, legs straight and together, arms crossed over her chest, and the torso lowered forward and down past horizontal so that her head hangs below the level of her hips | Realism: photorealistic photographic still from a real gym video shoot, full-frame camera, 50mm lens at f/4, natural soft studio light, realistic contact shadows where her hips rest on the pad, true-to-life fabric creases and skin detail, she looks alert and alive with natural breathing and believable joint angles and muscle tension, no CGI or illustration look | Constraints: same face and body, same studio and lighting; the whole machine and her whole body including her head and hands inside the frame with clear margin; realistic machine geometry; no text, no watermark, no logo, no brand marks.
exercises.endImagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural | Asset type: end frame for an exercise demonstration video, landscape 16:9, wide fixed camera from the side | Input image: the start frame of this same movement - keep the machine, the camera position, the studio, the lighting, her clothing and her hips resting on the hip pad exactly as in that image | Pose: the top position of the same back extension - her hips stay on the hip pad, both ankles stay under the ankle rollers, both legs stay straight and together, her arms stay crossed over her chest, and the torso is now raised all the way up until her head, shoulders, back and legs form one single straight line, chest lifted and no further extension beyond that straight line | Realism: photorealistic photographic still from a real gym video shoot, full-frame camera, 50mm lens at f/4, natural soft studio light, realistic contact shadows where her hips rest on the pad, true-to-life fabric creases and skin detail, she looks alert and alive with natural breathing and believable joint angles and muscle tension, no CGI or illustration look | Constraints: change only the torso angle and keep everything else identical; same face and body, same studio and lighting; the whole machine and her whole body inside the frame with clear margin; no text, no watermark, no logo, no brand marks.
exercises.prompt: Start on the back extension machine with her hips on the pad, ankles under the rollers and the torso lowered forward and down past horizontal. 0-0.5s rest. 0.5-2.4s lift the torso smoothly up until the body forms one straight line from head to heels, keeping the spine long and the movement coming from the hips. 2.4-3.2s hold briefly at the top without leaning past the straight line. 3.2-4.5s lower the torso slowly back down past horizontal to the lowered starting position. Final half second rest. The hips stay on the pad, the legs do not bend and the neck stays in line with the spine. Photorealistic real-gym look, natural soft studio lighting, no CGI. Preserve exact reference woman identity, gray top, black leggings, black shoes, studio and lighting. Fixed camera, whole machine and full body visible, realistic anatomy. One continuous five-second shot, no text, no speech or music.
